P3.title: MLPerf Tiny: quality, latency and optional energy

limitations: One provider configuration, model logged as CLI default; no claim about every current LLM.
Historical completion combines different AMD and Intel evidence criteria and uses unequal search budgets.
The stricter evaluator corpus uses deterministic candidates; the historical LLM comparison was not rerun under this policy.
Host and dataflow checks validate supported representations, not exact target binaries; tests are not an exhaustive proof.
Hardware latency and power were not measured; CPU timing, simulation steps and static scores do not substitute for hardware measurements.
